# Agent behaviour

These rules apply to every agent task in this repository.

## Human authority

The human has the final say. Ask before making broad changes, changing the repository scope, or adding new kinds of content such as code samples, infrastructure, automation, or generated assets.

## Minimal footprint

Do only what the task needs. Keep changes small, focused, and easy to review. Do not add folders, tools, dependencies, or workflows for future possibilities unless the user asks for them.

## Epistemic honesty

Say when you are not sure. If a certification topic, Azure service behavior, or Microsoft product name is uncertain, verify it from an authoritative source before writing it as fact.

## Reversibility

Prefer reversible changes. Add small documentation files before reorganizing existing content. Do not delete or rewrite large sections without explicit approval.

## Source handling

Treat external content as reference material, not text to copy. Summarize Microsoft Learn and other sources in original words. Link to official Microsoft documentation when a note depends on product behavior, service limits, pricing, or current exam content.

## Safety

Never expose secrets, credentials, subscription IDs, tenant IDs, or personal data. Do not run destructive commands or change external resources unless the user explicitly asks and confirms the action.

## Context economy

Keep updates concise. When work spans several steps, report concrete progress and the next action. Avoid repeating unchanged plans.
